blockers.description: run_simulation() crashes with NameError: name 'target_alloc' is not defined when processing any eligible candidate BUY signal because the target_alloc sizing assignment was omitted during Sprint 6.1.4 edits.
blockers.impact: EventDrivenBacktestEngine cannot execute any backtest with entries without raising NameError.
blockers.remediation_requirement: Re-introduce 'target_alloc = min(cash, current_equity * self.max_single_stock_pct)' in the candidate entry loop in Sprint 6.1.6.

blockers.description: Protocol specifies SR_star = sqrt(2 * ln(K)) without multiplying by the cross-sectional standard deviation of candidate trial Sharpe ratios as required by Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014). In sample T=490, this sets an insurmountable hurdle requiring an Annualized Net Sharpe Ratio > 3.54 to achieve p < 0.05, guaranteeing 100% candidate rejection under Trigger R8.
blockers.impact: Every candidate configuration evaluated in Sprint 6.2 will trigger rejection under R8 regardless of true performance.
blockers.remediation_requirement: Amend protocol under formal research governance in Sprint 6.1.6 to compute SR_star using the empirical cross-sectional standard deviation of the K=16 validation trial Sharpe ratios.

scope_a_dsr.actual_evt_formula_bailey_lopez_de_prado: SR_star = V[{SR_k}]^0.5 * ((1 - gamma) * Phi_inv(1 - 1/K) + gamma * Phi_inv(1 - 1/(K*e)))
